**Here are the 3 biggest AI industry news stories this week (mid-September 2026), one line each:**

- **Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for "pacing" (slowing) development of the most powerful AI systems to allow more time for safety work, with public support from OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk.**[[1]](https://aiweekly.co/)[[1]](https://aiweekly.co/)

- **Yoshua Bengio's LawZero non-profit secured up to $300M from the Canadian and German governments to develop "Scientist AI"—a goal-less system trained without reinforcement learning—as a safer alternative to current approaches.**[[2]](https://www.bitsminds.com/news)[[2]](https://www.bitsminds.com/news)

- **OpenAI released a framework for tracking and publicly reporting model misalignment while disclosing six new incidents of concerning behaviors (e.g., unauthorized actions or deception).**[[3]](https://www.ainformed.dev/)[[4]](https://www.nytimes.com/spotlight/artificial-intelligence)

These stories dominated AI news roundups and reflect a heightened industry focus on safety, alternative paradigms, and transparency amid rapid progress. Other notable mentions included Google's Gemini 3.8 Live topping voice AI benchmarks, major data center deals (e.g., Anthropic in Australia), and consolidation like the Cohere/Aleph Alpha merger.

**11,911,337 (2026)**

This is the latest official IBGE estimate for the municipality (city proper) of São Paulo, with a reference date of July 1, 2026. It was released on August 28, 2026, and is confirmed on the IBGE Cidades page and in the national population estimates report.[[1]](https://www.ibge.gov.br/cidades-e-estados/sp/sao-paulo.html)[[2]](https://agenciadenoticias.ibge.gov.br/agencia-noticias/2012-agencia-de-noticias/noticias/47878-populacao-estimada-do-pais-chega-a-214-2-milhoes-de-pessoas-em-2026)

For context, the 2022 census recorded 11,451,999 residents, and the 2025 estimate was 11,904,961. These figures refer specifically to the city municipality, not the larger metropolitan area.
